podcast.body: Released in March 1976, while the *Love to Love You Baby* album was still in the top 40, this album committed to the concept of extended length dance suites. It featured an 18-minute track, "Try Me, I Know We Can Make It," which occupied all of Side A. Tracks from this album reached number one on Billboard's Club Play chart, and the album went gold within weeks, though it did not generate a top 40 pop hit. "A love trilogy released in March 1976 while the love to love you album was still in the top 40, led off with the 18-minute track, Triming I Know We Can Make It, taking up all of Side-Aid."
